Your API key is stored securely in this session

A key is optional. The audit, token analysis, naming checks, auto-fixes and exports all run without one. Adding a key also generates component descriptions, property recommendations and enables Chat. Keys are billed separately from Claude Pro / Claude Team subscriptions — create one at platform.claude.com.

OpenRouter offers far more models than the shortlist above. Paste any slug from openrouter.ai/models to use it instead — leave blank to use the dropdown selection.

Using Azure or a custom endpoint? Set it up here

Route the OpenAI provider through your own OpenAI-compatible gateway instead of api.openai.com — most often Azure OpenAI / AI Foundry (https://YOUR-RESOURCE.openai.azure.com/openai/v1). Leave blank to use the default OpenAI endpoint. Paste the base URL; the /chat/completions route is added automatically. Azure keys are sent via the api-key header, other gateways via Authorization: Bearer.
Looking for OpenRouter? It's now its own entry in the AI Provider dropdown above — no endpoint setup needed.

Required for Azure: the exact model identifier the endpoint expects, which overrides the model dropdown above. For Azure that's the deployment name you created in your resource (deployment names are arbitrary, so it rarely matches the model name). A wrong or blank name is the usual cause of a 404 "model not found".

Find what to fix before handoff

Select a component and press Analyze. Most problems can be fixed from this panel in one click.

  • Hard-coded colors, spacing and radii that have a matching variable
  • Generic layer names like Frame 12 and Rectangle 4
  • Touch targets, contrast, focus and hover states
  • How well AI tools can read the component
